## Fence Types
vinyl_fencing:
  - Multiple colors and wood-grain textures
  - CertaGrain textured surface technology
  - Hurricane-approved options
  - Pool code compliant designs
  - Chesterfield, Lakeland, and other premium styles

wood_fencing:
  - Board-on-board privacy fencing
  - Post-and-rail traditional fencing
  - Custom wood fence designs
  - Pressure-treated, cedar, and cypress options
  - Picket fencing varieties

aluminum_fencing:
  - Ornamental aluminum designs
  - Avalon, Bentley, Capeview styles
  - Pool code compliant options
  - Commercial and residential grades
  - Powder-coated finishes

specialty_fencing:
  - EcoStone (granite appearance molded fence)
  - Chain link (galvanized, vinyl-coated)
  - Hurricane Ready Fencing (Florida State & Miami-Dade approved)
  - Composite wood fencing
  - Semi-privacy and privacy options
